boosters_i18n.zh-TW: 雙流國家森林遊樂區（林業保育署屏東分署官方頁，150-700m、白榕步道/帽子山步道/雙流瀑布；蝴蝶逾196種、螢火蟲季為官方生態資訊但查無可繫結的逐窗契約資料源，誠實不建時間窗）森林步道與瀑布展望主體（OSM nature_reserve 節點；海拔垂直分佈、單值誠實留空）；與既有 tw-155 旭海草原公園（7.33km）題材錯位。
boosters_i18n.en: Shuangliu National Forest Recreation Area (officially listed by the Forestry and Nature Conservation Agency Pingtung branch; 150-700 m, banyan/Hat-mountain trails and the Shuangliu waterfall). Firefly/butterfly season windows are official ecology notes but no bindable per-window data source - honestly no time-window contract; disjoint from tw-155 Xuhai grassland 7.33 km away.
boosters_i18n.ja: 双流国家森林遊楽区（林業保育署屏東分署公式、白榕・帽子山步道と双流瀑布）（OSM）。蛍・蝶の季節窓は権威源がなく誠実に不構築。旭海とは題材が別。

penalties_i18n.en: Severe weather, poor visibility, outside operating/season window.
penalties_i18n.ja: 悪天候、視程不良、営業・季節窓外。
